scope: Explicit bounded visual approval after full current-source inspection; independent runtime/physics/timing reports remain required. Not a universal flawlessness claim.
method: Eight current whole-scene contact sheets plus full-size critical assemblies and genuine close-ups. Forced player LOD0/1 retained smooth appearance; forced close LOD3 deliberately coarse, technical-only. Exact native roof40/exterior30 and window87 confirmed after inward crown repair.
limits: Representative native poses and distances; source tests separately cover all24body/chair pairs.
Graphite feed-guide flanges are backed by actual wall/reveal; exact owners checked separately.
Distant landscape/airfield is simpler than the furnished passenger spaces.
Flight timing and audible playback need separate evidence.
